name: Channel partner fit review
summary: When a referral, reseller or alliance partner approaches, the founder or head of partnerships gets one review: evidence the partner brings customers of its own, the type that evidence supports, a ninety-day plan with signs to go on or stop, and the commission range that still beats selling direct. A person decides.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work: the organization's own figures as the only basis for the economics, with no typical rates supplied; every claim marked confirmed, stated by the partner or unknown, with confirmation only from someone other than the partner; named customers checked against the organization's own accounts export; the year break-even rate at the partner's promised volume; ninety-day targets worked out from that volume and the organization's win rate; agreement terms set aside for the person who handles them; and a person who decides and replies.

sources.contribution: Building the review around the moment a would-be partner gets in touch: whether it brings buyers or mainly wants better terms, which type it should be, how a first quarter would prove it and what rate still pays better than selling yourself, with a person making the choice; and, for selling together, asking for the shared offer in one sentence with the customer it is for, an outcome neither side could deliver alone.

Asking for the past year's customers that you would want too, counting only people who are paid to sell, writing unknown in place of a guess, and a few warning signs such as a hurry to sign and a region asked for outright.
Partner types that run from passing on introductions to selling together, and checking whether the customers a partner names already knew you.
A first ninety days with groundwork, a midpoint check and a choice at the end to carry on, change or stop, and asking whether a reseller can sell with none of your own salespeople present.

Settling in advance what would end a partnership, making any marketing money pay for a specific activity with a stated return, putting conditions on any region held alone, and paying only for introductions that were new.
Setting the margin on a deal you win yourself beside the same deal won through a partner, and counting how many partner deals a year cover the partnership's fixed cost.
Placing a partner at the most demanding type it fully qualifies for, with referral to fall back on.
Letting the partner's type decide which steps the plan holds, so a partner that only introduces is given no selling steps.
